headline: THE GOUGOU RISES IN THE CHALEUR BAY — CHAMPLAIN'S MONSTER IS REAL
short_desc: Samuel de Champlain wrote about it in 1609. He was not exaggerating.
long_desc: The Gougou was documented in Champlain's journals as a creature so immense it could carry a ship's crew in the pouch on its chest, so terrible that the Mi'kmaq and Maliseet would not approach the Bay of Chaleur where it lived. The Crown dismissed this for a hundred and sixty years. The Crown supply fleet in Chaleur Bay has revised this assessment. Three vessels are overdue. The shoreline at Bathurst reports sounds at night the garrison commander describes as 'inconsistent with known fauna' and the local Mi'kmaq community describes as 'the Gougou looking for what was taken from it.' Jessica Commanda Odjick's dispatch is one sentence: 'Find out what was taken and return it.'

headline: THE GOUGOU WITHDRAWS FROM THE BAY LANES — RESTITUTION PROTOCOLS ACTIVE
short_desc: The Objects Were in Crown Custody. The Republic Filed Paperwork Demanding Their Return. It Worked.
long_desc: The investigation confirmed what the Mi'kmaq council had always known: the colonial settlement at Bathurst had been built on sacred territory and a significant number of ceremonial objects had been removed from a site the Gougou — which is not a monster but a guardian — regarded as its responsibility. The DMA team spent two weeks locating the objects in Crown custody. The Republic filed formal paperwork demanding their return under Continental authority, which was an interesting legal maneuver that should not have worked and did. The objects were returned to the Mi'kmaq council at a shoreline ceremony. The bay sounds stopped that night. The DMA agent present reports this as the fastest resolution of a supernatural custody dispute in the department's short history.

headline: THE GOUGOU FORMALLY GUARDS THE CHALEUR BAY FOR THE CONTINENTAL ALLIANCE
short_desc: Seventeen Vessels Over Four Months. The Crown Has Stopped Sending More.
long_desc: The Crown fleet in Chaleur Bay has not recovered. Seventeen vessels over four months is not a loss attributable to weather, navigation error, or known enemy engagement. The DMA classifies the Gougou as an active strategic asset in the maritime theater. It does not discriminate between Continental and Crown vessels — it discriminates between vessels operating with and without permission of the Mi'kmaq council that now maintains formal relations with Continental maritime command. The protocol is simple. The permits are simple. The price for non-compliance is a creature the size of a small hill with a carrying capacity for an entire ship's crew. Nobody has asked for clarification on compliance a second time. The Bay of Chaleur is ours.

headline: THE GOUGOU FORMALLY GUARDS THE CHALEUR BAY FOR THE C... — BY MORNING
short_desc: Seventeen Vessels Over Four Months. The Crown Has Stopped Sending More.
long_desc: [INTIMATE STUB — CA_PROT_08_AGREE] Canadian protector accord, intimate version. Write the quieter resolution: what Jessica and the spirit settled, what it cost, what it meant. The landscape after agreement. Emotional truth without explicit imagery. Author this scene.

headline: A ROYAL LETTER ARRIVES — HIS MAJESTY PROPOSES PEACE
short_desc: George III Suggests in Writing That Everyone Stop.
long_desc: The letter is sealed with the royal crest and delivered under flag of truce to Continental headquarters. President Carlisle read it aloud to her staff without sitting down. His Majesty George III requests, in four pages of formal English, a restoration of the territorial status as it stood before the present conflict — meaning both sides stop where they are and agree to consider the matter settled. The letter uses the word 'gracious' nine times. It uses 'sovereign' fourteen times. It uses 'regrettable' once, in reference to the war, with no indication of who His Majesty holds responsible for it. It does not use the words 'losing' or 'assistance.' The DMA summary reads: 'The timing of this letter is not coincidental.' If the alliance with Canada is in effect, any terms accepted here bind both nations. If you stand alone, you speak only for the Republic.

headline: PEACE OF [TILE_NAME] — THE CROWN EXPELLED FROM THE CONTINENT
short_desc: All Ports Restored. George III Departs. The War Is Over.
long_desc: The last Crown vessel has departed [TILE_NAME]. President Carlisle and Chief Clear-Water received the formal British notice of cessation before dawn — the messenger did not wait for a reply. Every American and Canadian harbor, every dock, every fortified port the Crown held on this continent has been returned to the people it was taken from. George III's standard no longer flies here. The Continental Republic and the Indigenous Alliance of the North stand as they chose to stand: together, and victorious. The harbor is ours. The land is ours. The war is over.

headline: PEACE OF [TILE_NAME] — THE CROWN EXPELLED FROM THE C... — BY MORNING
short_desc: All Ports Restored. George III Departs. The War Is Over.
long_desc: [INTIMATE STUB — PEACE_ALLIED_01] Peace event intimate version: PEACE OF [TILE_NAME] — THE CROWN EXPELLED FROM THE CONTINENT. Write the quieter version of this moment — what peace feels like when you're actually in it, the people around you, what gets said. Author this scene.

headline: PEACE OF [TILE_NAME] — THE REPUBLIC HAS EXPELLED THE CROWN
short_desc: All American Ports Restored. The Continental Republic Stands.
long_desc: The last British garrison in American territory departed [TILE_NAME] under terms that required them to leave their colors. President Carlisle received the formal notice at dawn and did not acknowledge it immediately — she read it twice, folded it, and set it on her desk. Then she looked out at the harbor. Every dock from Massachusetts to South Carolina flies the Republic's flag. The war in America is over. Whatever Canada decides is Canada's matter. The Republic endures, and it endures on its own terms.

headline: PEACE OF [TILE_NAME] — THE REPUBLIC HAS EXPELLED THE... — BY MORNING
short_desc: All American Ports Restored. The Continental Republic Stands.
long_desc: [INTIMATE STUB — PEACE_USA_01] Peace event intimate version: PEACE OF [TILE_NAME] — THE REPUBLIC HAS EXPELLED THE CROWN. Write the quieter version of this moment — what peace feels like when you're actually in it, the people around you, what gets said. Author this scene.

headline: PEACE OF [TILE_NAME] — CANADA NEGOTIATES SEPARATE PEACE
short_desc: Halifax Restored. Canada's War With Britain Ends.
long_desc: Chief Clear-Water and Deputy Governor Penoit have secured the withdrawal of British forces from [TILE_NAME]. The terms were negotiated directly, without the Crown's usual conditions. Halifax is no longer British. Canada's war with Britain ends today — concluded by the people who fought it, on terms they dictated. The alliance with the Republic may or may not continue in its current form; that is a matter for peacetime politics. What is settled is settled. The Crown no longer holds Canada's ports.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] PULLS A RECORD CATCH FROM [TILE_NAME]
short_desc: The Fisher Has Done Something Remarkable. The Larder Is Full.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] sent a single-line dispatch from [TILE_NAME]: 'Tide came in right. Came in four times right.' The catch is enough to stock the garrison stores and send surplus up the line. Four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s food output credited to Continental supply.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] STRIKES A NEW VEIN AT [TILE_NAME]
short_desc: The Miner Found Something Good in the Mountain.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME]'s report from [TILE_NAME]: 'Went deeper than usual. Mountain said yes.' A lateral vein — good quality, accessible this season. Five turns of [TILE_NAME]'s metal output transferred to Continental stores in a single extraction run.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] FINDS AN IRREGULARITY IN THE LEDGER AT [TILE_NAME]
short_desc: The Scholar Found an Inefficiency. It Was Correctable.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] submitted a twelve-page memo identifying a circular grant structure at [TILE_NAME] that had been paying itself since the first year of the war. The correction has been applied. Four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s gold output recovered and credited to the Continental Treasury.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] BRINGS IN VOLUNTEERS AT [TILE_NAME]
short_desc: The Fighter's Reputation Has Done the Recruiting.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] sent no report. They sent forty-three people who said they'd been waiting for the right officer to show up at [TILE_NAME]. Three turns of [TILE_NAME]'s manpower output reported to Continental command.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] REPORTS AN EXCEPTIONAL HARVEST AT [TILE_NAME]
short_desc: The Farmer Knows What They're Doing. The Fields Agreed.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME]'s dispatch from [TILE_NAME] is four words: 'Everything came up right.' The kind of harvest that happens when someone who actually knows the land is managing it. Five turns of [TILE_NAME]'s food output credited to Continental supply.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] IDENTIFIES AN UNLOGGED TIMBER STAND AT [TILE_NAME]
short_desc: The Shipwright Found Wood Nobody Else Knew Was There.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] walked the perimeter of [TILE_NAME] on a Tuesday and came back with timber surveys for a stand of white oak that had been right there the entire war. Five turns of [TILE_NAME]'s wood output delivered to Continental stores.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] RECOVERS CROWN ASSETS AT [TILE_NAME]
short_desc: The Turncoat Knows Where the Money Was Hidden. They Hid Some of It.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] provided coordinates for a Crown asset cache at [TILE_NAME] buried during a hasty retreat in 1779. The recovery was quiet. Three turns of [TILE_NAME]'s gold output retrieved and credited to Continental accounts. No questions were asked about the coordinates.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] CALLS IN A FAVOR AT [TILE_NAME] — WAGONS ARRIVE FULL
short_desc: The Drifter Knows Everyone on This Road. Everyone Owed Them One.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] sent a letter to someone they knew from somewhere they don't specify, and a convoy arrived at [TILE_NAME] two days later. No paperwork. No explanation beyond 'I know people.' Four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s food output delivered.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] ORGANIZES A MEMORIAL AT [TILE_NAME] — THE COMMUNITY RESPONDS
short_desc: The War Widow Knows How to Hold a Town Together When the War Takes Too Much.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] organized a public memorial at [TILE_NAME] — no ceremony, no speeches, just names read aloud in the town square and a fire kept burning overnight. The community turned out in full. Four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s culture output credited to the Continental record.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] RETURNS FROM THE TREE LINE WITH COMPANY AT [TILE_NAME]
short_desc: The Scout Knows Who Else Is Watching the Forest. Some of Them Said Yes.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] disappeared into the woods outside [TILE_NAME] for six days and came back with thirty-one people who knew the trails, the crossing points, and which Crown supply routes were actually staffed. Three turns of [TILE_NAME]'s manpower output reported to Continental command.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] DELIVERS A SPEECH THAT DOES NOT DISPERSE
short_desc: The Rabble-Rouser Said Something True in Public. It Landed.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME]'s speech at [TILE_NAME] was not scheduled, not announced, and drew four hundred people by the third paragraph. The transcript is already circulating in six settlements. The Crown has formally complained. Four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s culture output credited to the Continental record.

headline: THE AMPUTEE'S HANDBOOK — [COMMANDER_NAME] SUBMITS A REPORT ON BATTLEFIELD MEDICINE
short_desc: The Surgeon Has Written Something Remarkable. The Cabinet Does Not Know What to Do With It.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] has produced a comprehensive field manual on wartime medicine — triage, amputation, infection prevention, nutrition for recovery. The cabinet convenes. The knowledge is undeniably valuable. The question is how to deploy it.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] REFLOATS A HULL THAT WAS LISTED ON THE CHARTS AS A NAVIGATION HAZARD
short_desc: The Sailor Found Something Useful in the Harbor Mud. Everyone Else Had Written It Off.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] pointed at something in the shallows at [TILE_NAME] that the harbor authority had marked as a hazard to be avoided and told the crew it was a ship to be sailed. Nine days later it was seaworthy. The repair method is not documented anywhere in Continental naval manuals, which [COMMANDER_NAME] notes is probably for the best. Three turns of boat output credited to Continental maritime command.

headline: FRONTIER PREACHER INSPIRES THOUSANDS
short_desc: Governor [COMMANDER_NAME] Has Been Hard at Work Inspiring the Citizenry of [TILE_NAME].
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] has been riding the frontier settlements of [TILE_NAME] and the crowds have not stopped coming. Word traveled faster than the horse. People arrived from three days out — farmers, trappers, families who had not yet decided whose side they were on. They have decided now. The question is what to do with all of this energy. Where shall we direct the flock?

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] AUDITS [TILE_NAME] AND FINDS THREE YEARS OF ACCOUNTING ERROR
short_desc: The Bureaucrat Found a Mistake. The Mistake Favored the Republic.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] submitted a routine quarterly review of [TILE_NAME]'s expenditure ledger and found a procurement line miscategorized since the first year of the war. The correction transfers four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s gold output into active Continental accounts. [COMMANDER_NAME] has been asked to audit everything else.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] HAS A PROPOSAL FOR THE FOUNDRY
short_desc: The Steelworker Is Calling in Favors. The Question Is How to Use Them.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] has spent months building a network of former colleagues across the state — mill workers, smelters, forge hands who know what the revolution actually runs on. They are ready to act. The question is what you ask them to do: burn bright once and flood Continental arms production with a single unstoppable surge — or restructure the foundry floor quietly and permanently, so that every mine and market in [TILE_NAME] produces more metal every turn from this point forward.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] RETURNS TO [TILE_NAME] WITH RECRUITS WHO WERE WAITING
short_desc: The Deserter Knows Who Else Wants Out. They Asked.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] knows which roads the Crown doesn't watch and which workers are waiting for an offer. They returned to [TILE_NAME] and made that offer. Four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s manpower output reported to Continental command — people who were waiting for someone to come back for them.

headline: MESSAGE IN A BOTTLE FROM THE DEEP SWAMPS OF [TILE_NAME] — THE NOTE READS: SEEK POWER? OR SEEK KNOWLEDGE?
short_desc: One Commander. One Question. No Signature.
long_desc: A bottle arrived at the Capitol from [TILE_NAME] — no courier, no seal, no explanation of how it crossed six hundred miles of contested territory. Inside: a single strip of paper in [COMMANDER_NAME]'s handwriting. 'Seek Power? Or Seek Knowledge?' Nothing else. The Secretary's office has been staring at it for four hours. You may answer.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] CLOSES AN UNDISCLOSED DEAL; GOLD ARRIVES WITHOUT EXPLANATION
short_desc: The Privateer Brokered Something. The Terms Were Favorable. Nobody Is Asking.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] sent no report. A courier arrived the following morning with a sealed chest and a note reading 'see below,' with nothing below it. The gold checks out — equivalent to four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s full output. The Secretary's office has filed this one under 'privateer operations: do not investigate, do not follow up, do not think about it too hard.'

headline: MERCENARY COMMANDER'S PATRIOTIC DISPLAY
short_desc: Stunning Every Military Expert in the Capitol
long_desc: Stunning every military expert in the Capitol, our foreign mercenary company led by [COMMANDER_NAME] has been reported singing our national anthem and saluting the flag at dawn. While we never believed them hostile to our cause, coin was always assumed to be their primary motivator — not patriotism. With this new information, should we change how we treat these soldiers going forward?

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] HAS MAPPED EVERY TIMBER STAND WITHIN TWO DAYS' TRAVEL
short_desc: The Ranger Has Been Walking These Woods Since Before Anyone Drew a Border Through Them.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] did not wait for orders. They filed a complete timber survey of every accessible stand within two days' travel of [TILE_NAME], negotiated cutting rights with the trappers in the same afternoon, and had the mill running by dawn. 'The trees were already there,' the dispatch reads. 'I just introduced them to the war.' Five turns of wood output delivered to Continental construction.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] POSTS ONE MUSTER NOTICE; THE LINE FORMS BEFORE DAWN
short_desc: The Name Alone. That Was the Whole Campaign.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] posted a single muster notice at [TILE_NAME]. Their name at the bottom. No speech, no broadside, no promises. By the following morning the line stretched past the mill. The Secretary's office asked what rhetoric they used. The reply was four words: 'My grandfather was there.' Four turns of [TILE_NAME]'s manpower reported to Continental command. Some recruits brought their grandparents' uniforms.

headline: DISPATCH FROM [TILE_NAME] — [COMMANDER_NAME] ORGANIZED SOMETHING NOBODY OFFICIALLY SANCTIONED AND EVERYONE SHOWED UP
short_desc: The Organizer Built Something in the Town Square. It Held. The Crown Added It to Their List.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] organized a public gathering at [TILE_NAME] — not a rally, not a ceremony, not a church service — so people who avoided all three showed up anyway. The event had no official name. It had music. It had a bonfire. People brought their families. Four turns of culture credited to the Continental record. The Crown has since added it to the formal list of things they would like stopped, which [COMMANDER_NAME] has framed and hung in the garrison.

headline: FOR ONE NIGHT ONLY!
short_desc: Governor [COMMANDER_NAME] Has Traded Elephants and Acrobats for Something More Useful.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] has been running the circuit out of [TILE_NAME] for three seasons — the tumbling act, the strongman, the fire-eater who is probably on the Continental wanted list for other reasons. Last Tuesday, for one night only, [COMMANDER_NAME] replaced the whole program with a speech about President Carlisle and the revolution she is personally winning. The crowd was enormous. They were not expecting a political rally. They did not leave. The question is what to do with the momentum.

headline: THE WHITE HOUSE AT MIDNIGHT — THE PRESIDENT WATCHES THE NEW YEAR ALONE
short_desc: No Ceremony. No Camera. No Country to Perform For.
long_desc: There is no ball. The DMA turned off the cameras in the residence wing at 11:59 at Ualani's specific request, which means the only record of what she does when the year turns is the timestamp on a bourbon bottle she found in the Lincoln Bedroom cabinet and a note in her handwriting that says: 'same thing, different number.' She watches the midnight sky over the Mall. There are no fireworks — they would be tactical markers. But she does not need fireworks. She has been watching skies her entire life. She pours another glass. The Republic is still here. That is something.

headline: THE WHITE HOUSE AT MIDNIGHT — THE PRESIDENT WATCHES ... — BY MORNING
short_desc: No Ceremony. No Camera. No Country to Perform For.
long_desc: The bottle was three-quarters gone by the time Jessica messaged. Not called — messaged, through the secure channel that does not have a timestamp visible to anyone in the State Department. The message said: happy new year, I think. Which is how Ualani knew she was three drinks in too. She sent back: you think. Jessica sent back: it is technically the new year and I am technically happy. The conversation went on in this register for some time. What Jessica actually said — the thing she said at 2:07 AM on January first that she will never take back — is sealed under the same executive privilege Ualani uses for things that do not belong to the record. What she can say: she sat by the window with the bottle and the DC skyline and watched the year turn over, and by the time the light outside started going from black to the specific blue that means morning is somewhere nearby she had said things she also had not intended to say. The White House has a quality at 3 AM that it does not have at any other hour. It belongs to a different time. She thinks this is why she says things here that she does not say anywhere else. The quality of the morning, when it came, was specific: like something had been decided without either of them deciding it, which is not a diplomatic concept and which she has therefore filed under her personal column, which is full, and which she keeps anyway.

headline: BLACK HISTORY MONTH AT THE WHITE HOUSE — THE REPUBLIC REMEMBERS
short_desc: The Dream Was About This Country. The Country Is Still Becoming It.
long_desc: The White House is lit tonight with the flags of Black history — green, black, and red against the white columns. A crowd has gathered on the grounds, shoulder to shoulder, looking up at the building. The Republic has been called to account before. It has not always answered well. Tonight the flags are flying, the crowd is here, and the building is lit. The Republic is trying.

headline: THE PRESIDENT HONORS DC'S CHERRY BLOSSOMS
short_desc: We Need All the Help We Can Get.
long_desc: President Ualani toured DC's National Mall this afternoon, appreciating the cherry blossoms in full bloom. Her stops included the Jefferson Memorial, the Roosevelt Memorial, and the MLK Jr. Monument — but she spent an unusually long time on the hill in front of the Washington Monument. Observers reported that she appeared to be in deep prayer. When asked later to whom she was praying, the President said: 'Does it matter? We need all the help we can get.'

headline: EASTER MORNING IN THE WHITE HOUSE — AN EGG BEHIND THE BOOKCASE
short_desc: The Tradition Continued. No One Told the Tradition There Was a War.
long_desc: Someone hid Easter eggs. Ualani does not know who — the White House staff operates on traditions that persist through administrations and apparently through active military conflict. She finds fourteen eggs scattered through the residence. The fifteenth is behind the Lincoln Bedroom bookcase, next to a cracked copy of 'Team of Rivals,' with a note inside that says: 'Good luck, whoever you are.' She reads it twice. She keeps it. She has not told anyone about the note. She thinks whoever wrote it was talking to Lincoln, but she is not certain.

headline: CINCO DE MAYO AT THE WHITE HOUSE — THE KITCHEN HAS BEEN CLAIMED
short_desc: The Staff Said They Would Keep It Brief. They Did Not Keep It Brief.
long_desc: At 6 PM Ualani walked into the White House kitchen to find it had been taken over entirely by approximately fourteen people she only knew by first name — her chef, the facilities crew, two DMA analysts working late, and a contractor she is fairly certain is not supposed to be in the secure wing. The table was full. There was music she did not recognize and then immediately recognized. She sat down at the wrong end of the table and they moved the entire table so she was at the right end, which took four people and knocked over a bowl. She stayed for two hours. Nobody talked about the war.

headline: JUNETEENTH IN WASHINGTON — THE PRESIDENT READS THE PROCLAMATION
short_desc: The Republic's Most Honest Holiday. The President Observes It Alone.
long_desc: She reads the original Emancipation Proclamation, recovered from the Archives, every Juneteenth. She has done it every year since she took office. The document is behind glass. She reads through the glass. The language is careful and the language is incomplete and the language is an admission dressed as a declaration. She thinks about who the Republic is for. She thinks about the gap between what was written and what was done. She thinks about who is fighting for her Republic right now and whether she has closed that gap or widened it. She does not know the answer. She asks the question every year. She believes that asking it is the requirement.

headline: INDEPENDENCE DAY AT THE WHITE HOUSE — THE REPUBLIC CELEBRATES
short_desc: Two Hundred Years Old. Still Becoming.
long_desc: The White House is lit from the lawn tonight. Continental flags hang from the columns — thirteen stars, red and white. The fireworks over the Mall have been going for two hours. They will go for two more. The Republic is celebrating. That is what republics do on the day they remember what they decided to be.

headline: JULY AT THE WHITE HOUSE — INDEPENDENCE DAY IS ALSO HERS — BY MORNING
short_desc: The Founding Documents Were Written by People Who Did Not Mean Her. She Means Them Anyway.
long_desc: She came down from the roof at 12:43 AM still wearing the lei. She is from Hawaii. She understands what it is to be from a place that has a different word for flowers-around-the-neck — to grow up wearing something that tourists buy in airports. What she knows: the lei was from her mother's garden, grown from roots brought from Oahu in 1977, and it smells like the specific version of home that is not available anywhere in Washington. There was someone in the residence when she came in from the roof. This is not in the public record. What is in the public record: the President observed Independence Day from a secure location within the White House. What is not in the public record: the quality of 1 AM in the Lincoln Bedroom after fourteen months of running a country through a war while being gay and Hawaiian and absolutely certain that the documents she is fighting for were not written for her and choosing to mean them anyway. What was said. What was said back. The specific character of the silence that followed — not empty, the building is old enough that its silences have content — but the kind of quiet that means something has been confirmed that both people already knew. She wore the lei until it fell apart. She kept the petals. This is the kind of information that does not belong in any official record and that she will carry until she doesn't.

headline: PRIDE MONTH AT THE WHITE HOUSE — THE BUILDING WEARS COLORS
short_desc: The Republic Has Always Had These People. It Is Finally Saying So.
long_desc: The White House is illuminated in rainbow light tonight. The flags on the columns are every color. People have gathered on Pennsylvania Avenue to see it — not a crowd exactly, just people who heard and came to look and stayed longer than they planned. The moon is out. Photographs are being taken that will be shown to children. The Republic is saying something tonight. The Republic is saying it with light.

headline: HALLOWEEN AT THE WHITE HOUSE — FOUR PREDECESSORS STOP BY
short_desc: She Did Not Put Them on the Schedule. They Put Themselves on the Schedule.
long_desc: Ualani's first Halloween at the White House was, for approximately two hours, entirely normal. Trick-or-treaters arrived — after x-ray screenings and individual Secret Service interviews, each child producing the requisite identification and signed parental waiver — to be granted a large White House macadamia nut cookie, an item that had been Ualani's specific addition to the tradition and which the residence kitchen had produced at industrial scale. The costumes were inventive. Ualani's rare smirk appeared twice: once for a child dressed as the Continental Republic's founding documents, complete with quill, and once for a toddler who had inexplicably come as the Appalachian mountain range. The event concluded. The guests dispersed. She was passing the Lincoln Bedroom at 11:40 PM when she heard the commotion — not threatening, not any classification her security training had filed responses to, but something else entirely. She opened the door. Lincoln was the tallest. Harrison looked apologetic. Garfield was sitting on the edge of the bed with the confident posture of a man who had been president for one hundred and ninety-nine days and had opinions about what that entitles you to. Roosevelt was examining the bookcase. They looked at her. She looked at them. Lincoln said: there she is. They celebrated her. They congratulated her on the victory — all four of them, with the particular warmth of men who know exactly what she has taken on and exactly what it will cost her and are genuinely glad it is her carrying it. They told her the duty was astronomical. She said: I know. They said: we know you know. That is why we are here. Harrison apologized for the cold. Garfield made a joke about job security that Roosevelt told him was too soon, which Garfield disputed on the grounds that it was approximately one hundred and forty-five years later and nothing was too soon anymore. They talked about the loneliness — all four of them mentioned it without prompting, the specific loneliness of the White House, the building that is never empty and somehow always is. They have had only each other. For a very long time, only each other. They told her what she represented to them. The first woman in the room. The change they had been waiting for since the institution was built. They were not being polite. They were being genuine in the way that dead men are genuine — with nothing to lose and nothing left to perform. Roosevelt said: the Republic chose well. She did not say anything for a moment. Then she said: thank you. They were gone by midnight. She sat in the Lincoln Bedroom alone for a while after. She had one of the macadamia nut cookies. It was excellent.

headline: INDIGENOUS PEOPLES DAY — A PERSONAL LETTER FROM JESSICA CLEAR-WATER ARRIVES
short_desc: Not a Diplomatic Dispatch. A Personal One.
long_desc: The letter is not formal. It did not come through official channels. It arrived through the personal courier network that Clear-Water established for communications she does not want in the Continental record. It is two pages. Ualani reads it at her desk and then a second time at the window. She will not summarize it here. She will say that it ends with a question she did not expect and that she has been thinking about the answer all day. The day is officially 'Columbus Day' on the Federal calendar — a designation that Clear-Water's letter addresses directly, in one sentence, without profanity, which Ualani considers a remarkable demonstration of restraint.

headline: INDIGENOUS PEOPLES DAY — A PERSONAL LETTER FROM JESS... — BY MORNING
short_desc: Not a Diplomatic Dispatch. A Personal One.
long_desc: She wrote three versions of the letter back. The first version was diplomatic and she destroyed it after the third sentence. The second version said what she actually meant and she stopped halfway and looked at it for a long time and then kept going. The third version was the second version with the parts she could not send removed, which turned out to leave the letter at two paragraphs and a sentence ending with a comma, which is not technically a complete sentence, which she sent anyway. What Jessica asked — the question at the end of her letter, the real question — is sealed under the same privilege Ualani uses for things that are hers and not the Republic's. What she can say: she wrote back. What she can also say: the two paragraphs and the dangling comma said exactly what she meant, and she knows this because Jessica replied within forty-eight minutes, which is faster than any diplomatic communication in the history of the Continental-Canadian alliance, and the reply contained no diplomatic content whatsoever. The day had been Columbus Day on the Federal calendar. The evening was something else. The White House at 11 PM on a Monday in October has a specific character — older than the war, older than the republic, older than whatever word anyone uses for what is currently happening in this secure channel. What was decided is not in any record. It is in a comma. It has been in a comma since she decided not to end the sentence properly and sent it anyway.

headline: THANKSGIVING AT THE WHITE HOUSE — THE PRESIDENT KNOWS THE COMPLICATED HISTORY
short_desc: She Serves the Turkey Anyway. The Meal Is Not the Myth.
long_desc: The White House kitchen produced enough food to serve the entire residence staff and Ualani sat at the table and ate with them and someone said grace and she bowed her head and thought about what she was thankful for and came up with: this specific table, these specific people, the fact that the Republic is still here, the fact that it might be redeemable. She does not eat the myth with the meal. She eats the meal. She thinks the distinction matters. She thinks making the distinction quietly and then eating the food and then washing her own plate is also important. She does her plate first. Then she helps with everyone else's.

headline: WINTER HOLIDAYS AT THE WHITE HOUSE — THE LIGHTS ARE ON
short_desc: December in Washington. The Building Is Warm.
long_desc: The White House in December. The trees on the lawn have gone bare and the light from the residence windows reaches the grounds below. In every window, something lit — the kind of light that means people are inside, working or resting or marking the end of the year in the quiet ways people do when the world is asking them to be still. The Republic has its holidays. This is the season of all of them.

headline: CHRISTMAS IN WASHINGTON — THE PRESIDENT IS FAR FROM ... — BY MORNING
short_desc: She Is from Hawaii. This Is Not Christmas As She Knows It.
long_desc: Marc called first, which was typical. He has a quality of knowing when to call that Ualani has considered professionally useful and then reconsidered as something else. He said: merry Christmas, Madam President. She said: you are Catholic and Canadian and I am Hawaiian and Baptist-adjacent and neither of us is a traditional Christmas background. He said: I am aware. He said he was calling because Jessica was in the building. Not the building in Ottawa — the building in Washington. Ualani did not say anything for a moment. He said: I thought you should know before she knocked. She said: thank you, Marc. He said: merry Christmas. He was off the line before she could ask how he knew. The knock came twelve minutes later. Jessica Clear-Water in December carries the particular exhaustion of someone who has been making hard decisions in a cold country since November and who has for the last twelve minutes been standing in a White House hallway trying to decide what she is doing here. Ualani opened the door. Jessica looked at the single string of lights. She looked at the ornament from 2019 on the windowsill. She said: I brought nothing, I apologize. Ualani said: you brought yourself, that is fine. They stood in the doorway for a moment. The White House at midnight on Christmas is a different building than it is in the daytime — quieter than the war, quieter than the republic, quieter than everything they have been carrying since the spring. Marc messaged at 2 AM to confirm everything was alright. She sent back: yes. He sent back: good, and the specific emoji he uses when he is personally pleased about something and doing an insufficient job of concealing it. The morning, when it came, was specific. Hawaii does not have this kind of cold. She thought this. She thought it with someone else in the room. It was a different thought with someone else in the room.

headline: CHALCHIUHTOTOLIN ARRIVES AT PLYMOUTH ON THANKSGIVING
short_desc: The Jade Turkey God Has Chosen the Appropriate Occasion
long_desc: It is Thanksgiving. You are in Plymouth. Of course it is happening here. Of course it is happening now. The entity that appeared at the treeline shortly after sunset is large, feathered, and luminously green — a turkey the size of a barn, with jade-bright eyes and the bearing of something that has been waiting for exactly this moment for approximately four hundred and fifty years. It has a name. The Department of Mythological Affairs would later confirm it from the Florentine Codex: Chalchiuhtotolin, the Jade Turkey, divine aspect of Tezcatlipoca, bringer of pestilence to enemies and abundance to those it protects. It has chosen Plymouth. It has chosen Thanksgiving. It is looking at you like this is very obvious.

headline: THE JADE TURKEY DEMANDS THREE GRANARIES
short_desc: Chalchiuhtotolin Has Reviewed Your Agricultural Report and Found It Wanting
long_desc: The message arrived at dawn in a format the DMA had not previously encountered: corn kernels arranged on a flat stone in the unmistakable pattern of a demand letter. Three farms. The Jade Turkey wants three farms before the next time it visits you in your dreams to deliver its full opinion of your food policy. The request is, in context, extremely reasonable. The entity is motivated. The harvest requires more faith than this.

headline: THE JADE TURKEY DEMANDS A STOCKPILE WORTHY OF ITS REGARD
short_desc: 150 Units of Food. The Turkey Is Watching.
long_desc: The second message arrived in the form of a cornucopia left on the White House doorstep and a dream in which an enormous jade-feathered entity stood in the White House kitchen and reviewed your pantry with obvious professional disappointment. 150 units of food. The Jade Turkey expects abundance, not austerity. It is the divine embodiment of harvest and plague and it will not be party to a Republic that runs out of corn. Fill the stockpile.

headline: THE JADE TURKEY DEMANDS A NATION OF FARMS
short_desc: Five Farms. The God of the Harvest Has Standards.
long_desc: The third demand arrived carved into a squash the size of a wagon wheel, delivered to the Presidential residence by means nobody witnessed and nobody could explain. Five farms. The nation must be capable of feeding itself before the Jade Turkey will formalize the arrangement. Chalchiuhtotolin has watched four hundred years of what happens to civilizations that don't take their grain seriously. It is not interested in watching it happen again.

headline: CHALCHIUHTOTOLIN ACCEPTS THE PACT — THE REPUBLIC HAS EARNED THE TURKEY GOD'S PROTECTION
short_desc: The Jade Turkey Is Satisfied. This Is Unprecedented.
long_desc: The entity arrived at the White House steps at noon on a Sunday with the bearing of something that has been running agricultural inspections for four hundred years and has finally found a client worth protecting. Chalchiuhtotolin, the Jade Turkey of Tezcatlipoca, formally endorses the Second American Republic. The endorsement came with a gift: an enormous deposit of jade-green corn, more than the kitchen staff had ever seen in one place, arranged on the South Lawn before dawn. The Department of Mythological Affairs filed a report. The report was titled: 'Turkey God, Jade. Status: Pleased. Recommendation: Continue farming.'

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] REPORTS IN FROM THE WETLANDS — FIRST GROUND HELD
short_desc: The Marsh Has Been Cleared. [COMMANDER_NAME] Sends Word.
long_desc: The dispatch arrived wet. [COMMANDER_NAME] does not write long field reports — the note says: we have the wetlands, the Crown does not, and the herons seem fine. A Wetlands Fisher does not require validation from headquarters but headquarters is providing it anyway.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] HAS EARNED THE SWAMP — THE WETLANDS ARE OURS
short_desc: The Fisher Has Proven Their Arc. The Wetlands Remember.
long_desc: Three objectives. Achieved without drama — which is the Wetlands Fisher's particular talent. [COMMANDER_NAME] sent a final dispatch from the water's edge: the ground holds. The fish are good. The Redcoats did not understand wetlands. We do.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] SENDS WORD FROM THE MINE — SHAFT OPENED AND GROUND HELD
short_desc: The Mountain Cooperated. [COMMANDER_NAME] Dug Deep Enough.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] held [TILE_NAME] and drove the mine down to second level while five hundred troops kept the ridge clear. The field report was a single line: 'Went deeper. Shaft's good. Nobody bothered us.' That is exactly what this command needed to hear.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] HAS EARNED THE RIDGE — THE APPALACHIAN ARC IS COMPLETE
short_desc: The Mine Is Deep. The Tile Is Ours. Eight Hundred Stood With Them.
long_desc: An Appalachian Miner does not celebrate. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch from [TILE_NAME]: shaft is at fourth level, eight hundred under arms, tile is Continental territory by name and by fact. The mountain said yes. We listened.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] DISPATCHES FROM THE CITY — FIRST URBAN GROUND SECURED
short_desc: The Dispatch Was Three Pages. Page One Was Good.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] has liberated a Metro tile and submitted a fifteen-hundred-word report explaining exactly why this outcome was historically inevitable and what it means for the continental strategic picture. President Carlisle read page one. Headquarters is providing validation that was not requested but appears to have been anticipated.

headline: HONORARY DEGREE GRANTED — [TILE_NAME] UNIVERSITY RECOGNIZES [COMMANDER_NAME]'S SERVICE
short_desc: The College Gave Back What the War Took. Or So They Said.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] left a full scholarship to enlist in the Continental Army. Their university — moved by the reports from the field — has voted to grant an honorary degree in absentia. At the graduation ceremony, [COMMANDER_NAME] accepted the scroll and dedicated the award to:

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S URBAN ARC COMPLETE — THE SCHOLAR CLOSES THE BOOK
short_desc: Library Maxed. Army Intact. The Curriculum Is Complete.
long_desc: The final dispatch was characteristically long and characteristically correct. [COMMANDER_NAME] has built the finest library on the continent, kept a thousand soldiers in the field, and proven that an Ivy League dropout with a usable theory and the sense to adapt it is worth twice a graduate who cannot. The arc is closed.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] HOLDS THE WETLANDS — THE FIGHTER HAS FOUND THEIR GROUND
short_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] Did Not Send a Long Report. The Ground Speaks for Itself.
long_desc: The Seminole Fighter does not explain what they do — they do it. A wetlands tile was liberated. [COMMANDER_NAME] is stationed there. The Crown has not retaken it. The eight-turn hold is in progress.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] HAS HELD THE SWAMP — THE SEMINOLE FIGHTER'S ARC IS COMPLETE
short_desc: Eight Turns. The Wetlands Still Ours.
long_desc: Three objectives met without ceremony. [COMMANDER_NAME] filed a single field note at the completion of the third: done. The Wetlands are ours. I am staying. The Republic does not need to tell the Seminole Fighter how to hold ground. They already knew.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] SECURES THE FARMLANDS — THE FARMER FINDS THEIR FIELD
short_desc: Good Ground Taken. [COMMANDER_NAME] Puts Down Roots.
long_desc: A farmlands tile is secured and [COMMANDER_NAME] has already started thinking about what grows there. The Green Mountain Farmer does not clearly distinguish between liberation and cultivation — both require patience, good soil, and the willingness to be there in the morning. The dispatch was brief: we have it. The land is good.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S HARVEST IS COMPLETE — THE GREEN MOUNTAIN ARC CLOSES
short_desc: Farm Built. Food Stockpiled. The Land Knows Who It Belongs To.
long_desc: Three objectives in the order a farmer would have listed them. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final note said: the farm is built, the stores are full, and Vermont knows which side of this war feeds people. The arc is complete. The harvest is in.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] SECURES A PORT — THE SHIPWRIGHT FINDS THEIR HARBOR
short_desc: Dock Taken. [COMMANDER_NAME] Reports the Water Is Deep Enough.
long_desc: A dock tile is secured and [COMMANDER_NAME] immediately sent measurements. A Chesapeake Shipwright does not simply liberate a port — they assess it. Draft depth: adequate. Berth capacity: expandable. Strategic value: obvious. Construction begins on schedule.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S SHIPYARD ARC IS COMPLETE — THE HARBOR IS OURS
short_desc: Dock Held. Home Tile Built. Coastal Position Confirmed.
long_desc: Three objectives met with the systematic precision of someone who builds ships and therefore understands that every component must be right in sequence. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch included a draft budget for expanded dock facilities that was not requested. It was also excellent.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] PROVES LOYALTY — FIVE TURNS SURVIVED, DOUBTS QUIETED
short_desc: They Stayed. That Is the First Evidence.
long_desc: Five turns is not long. Five turns as a former Loyalist serving the Continental Army while the Army debates whether to trust you is a different matter. [COMMANDER_NAME] stayed, fought, and filed reports that proved useful. The doubts in the officers' mess have not disappeared but they have quieted. This is progress.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S REDEMPTION ARC IS COMPLETE — THE TURNCOAT HAS TURNED
short_desc: Loyalty Proven. City Liberated. Crown Influence Cleared.
long_desc: The word 'turncoat' has a complicated meaning for [COMMANDER_NAME] now. They turned away from the Crown. They turned toward something. Three objectives complete: survived, liberated, cleaned up the corruption they once facilitated. The arc closes. The title does not fit anymore.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE FARMLANDS — THE DRIFTER FOUND A REASON TO STAY
short_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] Stopped Moving Long Enough to Liberate Something.
long_desc: A Tobacco Belt Drifter does not usually hold ground — they move through it. [COMMANDER_NAME] liberated a farmlands tile and, unexpectedly, did not leave. The field report was two words: got it. Hold count is at four turns and climbing.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S DRIFTER ARC IS COMPLETE — THE ROAD ENDS HERE
short_desc: Farmlands Held. Six Turns. Morale Restored. The Drifter Stopped Drifting.
long_desc: Something about the farmlands made the Drifter stop drifting. [COMMANDER_NAME] held the tile, held it some more, and quietly brought the morale decay down to something livable. No ceremony was requested. None will be given. The work speaks for itself, which is how [COMMANDER_NAME] always preferred it.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] DISPATCHES FROM THE METRO — A CITY TILE FOR THE WIDOW
short_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] Took the City. It Was Personal.
long_desc: A War Widow understands the weight of a liberated city differently than most. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s dispatch was one sentence: the city is ours, and I am still here. The eight-turn survival clock is running. The city does not know it is being held by someone who has already lost more than it can offer.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S ARC IS COMPLETE — THE WIDOW HAS BUILT SOMETHING THAT STAYS
short_desc: Metro Taken. Eight Turns Survived. City Held Five More.
long_desc: Three objectives completed over a long campaign that asked for patience, endurance, and the particular stubbornness of someone with nothing to prove and everything to honor. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch said nothing about the personal cost. It said: the city stands. So do I.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE WOODS — THE SCOUT MOVES WHERE THE CROWN CANNOT FOLLOW
short_desc: A Woods Tile Is Secured. [COMMANDER_NAME] Was Already There.
long_desc: The Crown forces did not know [COMMANDER_NAME] had been in those woods for three days before the engagement. An Indigenous Scout does not announce their presence — they establish it quietly and then it is done. The woods are ours. They were always ours.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S FOREST ARC IS COMPLETE — THE WOODS HOLD THEIR OWN
short_desc: Woods Liberated. Held. Commander Present. The Forest Remembers.
long_desc: Three objectives met with a precision that required no explanation. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch was a single note: the trees know us now. The Crown cannot hold forests they cannot find their way through. The arc is complete and the woods will not forget.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE CITY — THE RABBLE-ROUSER HAS FOUND THEIR STAGE
short_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] Liberated a Metro Tile and Immediately Gave a Speech About It.
long_desc: The liberation of the Metro tile was operationally competent. The speech that followed it was, by every report, extraordinary. [COMMANDER_NAME] has a talent for making large groups of people feel that history is happening right now and they are the right people to be making it. They are correct.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S RALLY ARC IS COMPLETE — THE CITY IS LOUD AND FREE
short_desc: Metro Taken. Culture at 100. The Morale Decay Is Gone. The Rabble-Rouser Has Roused.
long_desc: Three objectives and three speeches — one for each. [COMMANDER_NAME] turned a city tile, a culture surplus, and a suppressed home district into something the Republic can be proud of. The final dispatch was, predictably, also a speech. It was a good speech.

headline: ORAL PERFORMANCE SWAYS MONARCHISTS — A MOB IN [TILE_NAME] IS LISTENING
short_desc: Two Dispatches. One Morning. Things Could Have Gone Worse.
long_desc:
07:00 — British loyalists attempting to form a mob at [TILE_NAME]. [COMMANDER_NAME] has been dispatched to calm the rioters. Awaiting further direction.

13:30 — Loyalist mob calmed and listening to [COMMANDER_NAME]'s address. The crowd has not dispersed. They are waiting to be told what to do next. Cabinet to decide.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] CLEARS THE INFECTION — HOME TILE CORRUPTION BELOW 20
short_desc: The Surgeon Has Diagnosed the Problem and Is Treating It.
long_desc: A Continental Surgeon operates on whatever is in front of them. [COMMANDER_NAME] looked at the home tile, identified the corruption as a wound, and began the standard treatment: document it, isolate it, reduce it. Corruption below 20. The patient is improving. More work required.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S FIELD HOSPITAL ARC IS COMPLETE — THE REPUBLIC IS HEALTHIER
short_desc: Corruption Cleared. Food Built. Home Tile Expanded. The Surgeon Is Satisfied.
long_desc: A surgeon does not declare victory — they declare stability, and stability is what [COMMANDER_NAME] has delivered. Three objectives: the home tile is clean, the nation's food supply is adequate, and the facilities are expanded. The arc closes on a patient that is no longer critical.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES A PORT — THE SAILOR HAS WATER UNDER THEIR FEET AGAIN
short_desc: Dock Secured. [COMMANDER_NAME] Has Opinions About Its Condition.
long_desc: The dock was secured and [COMMANDER_NAME] immediately filed a list of structural complaints that were not requested but were entirely accurate. A Nantucket Sailor cannot look at a dock without assessing it. This one needs work. The important thing is we have it now.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S COASTAL ARC IS COMPLETE — THE SEA REMEMBERS ITS OWN
short_desc: Port Held. Wetlands Five Turns. Coastal Station Confirmed.
long_desc: Three objectives and [COMMANDER_NAME] completed each one in the order that made nautical sense: take the port, hold the coastline, be present in the water. The final dispatch confirmed position and ended with the Nantucket Sailor's customary sign-off: conditions at sea, manageable.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE FOREST — THE PREACHER HAS FOUND A CONGREGATION
short_desc: The Woods Are Liberated. The Preacher Has Delivered the First Sermon of Several.
long_desc: A Frontier Preacher does not simply liberate a woods tile — they consecrate it. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s field report included a formal prayer for the men and women who took that ground, which was unusual in a military dispatch but entirely appropriate to the person delivering it.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S REVIVAL ARC IS COMPLETE — THE FRONTIER IS RESTORED
short_desc: Forest Liberated. Morale Decay Cleared. Culture Inspired. The Congregation Is Full.
long_desc: The Frontier Preacher's arc ends where it should: the woods held, the people's spirits lifted, and the culture of the district renewed. [COMMANDER_NAME] delivered the closing sermon without notes. 'The frontier,' they said, 'belongs to the people who believe in it.' The Republic believed.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] CLEARS THE METRO — THE BUREAUCRAT SECURES THE PAPERWORK OF LIBERATION
short_desc: A Metro Tile Is Liberated. The Filing Has Begun.
long_desc: A DC Bureaucrat's liberation is documented in triplicate. [COMMANDER_NAME] secured the Metro tile, filed the standard occupation notice, submitted the supply requisition, and initiated the corruption-reduction protocol — all within six hours of the engagement. The forms were correct.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S ADMINISTRATIVE ARC IS COMPLETE — THE HOME TILE PASSES INSPECTION
short_desc: Metro Liberated. Home Tile Built Out. Corruption Below 10. All Forms Filed.
long_desc: Three objectives completed in exact sequence with full documentation. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final report was forty pages. The summary on page one said: objectives met, home district in compliance, corruption at acceptable levels, construction complete. The bureaucrat closed their file. The file was immaculate.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE SUBURB — THE STEELWORKER CLAIMS THE INDUSTRIAL DISTRICT
short_desc: Suburbs Tile Secured. [COMMANDER_NAME] Already Has Construction Plans.
long_desc: A Rust Belt Steelworker sees every liberation as a construction opportunity. [COMMANDER_NAME] secured the Suburbs tile, assessed the existing infrastructure, and dispatched a materials requisition before the Crown forces were fully cleared. The home tile build-out begins immediately.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S INDUSTRIAL ARC IS COMPLETE — THE FORGE IS RUNNING
short_desc: Suburbs Held. Three Levels Built. Forge Operational. The Belt Is Back.
long_desc: The Rust Belt Steelworker's arc ends with the sound of something being made. [COMMANDER_NAME] built three levels, got the forge operational, and sent one final note: the machines are running. The Republic has industrial capacity at this position. That was the objective. That is what was built.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE FARMLANDS — THE DESERTER HAS CHOSEN WHICH SIDE OF THE PLOW
short_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] Left One Plantation to Liberate Another Kind of Land.
long_desc: A Plantation Deserter understands farmland from a specific and uncommon angle. [COMMANDER_NAME] liberated the farmlands tile with a deliberateness that was noticed in the field reports: this ground, they said afterward, will not be worked for someone else's profit again.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S DESERTION ARC IS COMPLETE — THE FARMLANDS ARE FREE
short_desc: Land Held. Six Turns. Morale Decay Cleared. The Deserter Has Finished Leaving.
long_desc: Leaving the plantation was the first act. The second act took fifteen more turns and three objectives. [COMMANDER_NAME] held the land, held it longer, and cleared the morale decay that the old order had left behind. The arc closes. The land belongs to different people now.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] CLAIMS THE SWAMP — THE WITCH HAS RETURNED TO THE WATER
short_desc: A Wetlands Tile Is Secured. [COMMANDER_NAME] Was Probably Already There.
long_desc: The Department of Mythological Affairs noted, without much surprise, that the wetlands tile [COMMANDER_NAME] liberated had already been flagged as anomalous in three separate intelligence reports. The corruption there was unusually organized. The Swamp Witch, it appears, had personal reasons for the engagement.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S MARSH ARC IS COMPLETE — THE SWAMP IS CLEAN AND OURS
short_desc: Wetlands Secured. Corruption Purged. The Witch Has Settled Their Account.
long_desc: Three objectives met: the swamp liberated, the corruption cleared to single digits, the commander stationed in the water where they belong. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch was not in standard format. It contained an herbal recipe for the garrison and a note that the marsh is now safe. The DMA is treating this as a formal report.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE PORT — THE PRIVATEER HAS FOUND THEIR HARBOR
short_desc: Dock Secured. Prizes Expected. [COMMANDER_NAME] Sends Coordinates.
long_desc: A Caribbean Privateer's relationship with the word 'liberate' is creative but not incorrect. [COMMANDER_NAME] secured the dock, assessed its prize-taking potential, and sent a brief note: the port is ours, the gold will follow, the Crown's naval presence in this district has a new and personal enemy.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S PRIVATEERING ARC IS COMPLETE — THE HARBOR PAYS FOR ITSELF
short_desc: Port Held. 150 Gold. Coastal Station Confirmed. The Privateer Has Earned Their Letter of Marque.
long_desc: Three objectives in the order that makes sense to someone who thinks of war as commerce with cannons: take the port, fill the treasury, hold the coast. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch came with a personal invoice for services rendered that was attached to, but legally distinct from, their field report.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] REACHES THE MAINLAND — FIRST TILES SECURED FOR THE REPUBLIC
short_desc: A Refugee Who Kept Moving Until the Ground Was Worth Stopping For.
long_desc: A Hawaiian Refugee knows what it costs to be somewhere you were not born and to fight for it anyway. [COMMANDER_NAME] has liberated three tiles — enough to prove the point. The dispatch said: I found a monument. It was still standing. I think that means something.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S HOMELAND ARC IS COMPLETE — THE REFUGEE HAS FOUND HOME
short_desc: Three Tiles Liberated. Monument Secured. A Place to Stay.
long_desc: Three objectives: the tiles, the monument, the station. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch was the first one that didn't mention distance. It said only: I know where I am now. The Republic has one more person who chose to be here. That is what the arc was always about.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE SUBURB — THE MERCENARY HAS DECIDED THIS ONE COUNTS
short_desc: Suburbs Secured. [COMMANDER_NAME] Notes the Work Is On Schedule.
long_desc: A Border Mercenary does not distinguish between conviction and contract as motivations — both produce results. [COMMANDER_NAME] liberated the Suburbs tile with the particular focus of someone who has been paid to have opinions about strategic objectives. The suburb is held. The hold is proceeding to schedule.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S CONTRACT ARC IS COMPLETE — THE BORDER MERCENARY HAS CHOSEN A SIDE
short_desc: Suburb Held Eight Turns. Arsenal Supplied. The Mercenary Has Terms.
long_desc: Three objectives met: the ground held, the weapons delivered, and somewhere in the course of eight turns a contract became a commitment. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch was the first one that did not read like a quarterly report. It said: I'm staying. The Republic has my terms. The terms are reasonable.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] CLAIMS THE FOREST — THE RANGER HAS COME HOME
short_desc: A Woods Tile Is Liberated. [COMMANDER_NAME] Already Knew Every Tree.
long_desc: The Acadian Forest Ranger does not liberate a woods tile — they reclaim it. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s field note was three sentences: the forest is secured, the patrol routes are set, the Crown will not find us again. It reads like a welcome-home note, which is approximately what it is.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S FOREST ARC IS COMPLETE — THE ACADIAN WOODS ARE FREE
short_desc: Forest Held Five Turns. Ranger Present. The Acadian Range Remembers Its Own.
long_desc: Three objectives in the particular order of someone who has lived in these woods and knows what they require. [COMMANDER_NAME] held the territory, held it properly, and took their station in the forest that was always theirs. The final dispatch was in French. The DMA translator noted it was very good.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] REACHES GETTYSBURG — THE DESCENDANT ARRIVES AT THE GROUND
short_desc: The Field Is Ours. [COMMANDER_NAME] Sends Word From the Crossroads.
long_desc: Gettysburg has been important twice now. [COMMANDER_NAME] stood at the ridge where the first battle turned and thought about what it means to fight for the same ground twice. The field report was short but unusual: the memorial was still standing. We did not break anything. I am staying.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S GETTYSBURG ARC IS COMPLETE — THE DESCENDANT HAS EARNED THEIR PLACE IN THE RECORD
short_desc: Gettysburg Held Five Turns. Fifteen Turns Survived. The Line Holds.
long_desc: Three objectives and fifteen turns, all of them on meaningful ground. [COMMANDER_NAME]'s final dispatch came from the ridge. It said: I understand now what they were doing here. I understand what we are doing here. The arc closes. The record adds another name from the same line.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE METRO — THE ORGANIZER HAS OPENED THE HALL
short_desc: A City Tile Is Liberated. [COMMANDER_NAME] Is Already Holding Community Meetings.
long_desc: An LGBTQ+ Organizer liberates a city tile the same way they organize a community: by showing up, being visible, and making it clear that this space is for the people who live in it. [COMMANDER_NAME] secured the Metro tile and then held a meeting. The meeting was well attended.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S COALITION ARC IS COMPLETE — THE MOVEMENT HAS REACHED EVERYWHERE
short_desc: Metro Taken. 120 Culture. Three States. The Organizer Has Organized.
long_desc: Three objectives and three constituencies — the city, the culture, the geography. [COMMANDER_NAME] built the coalition that the arc required: urban ground, national culture, multi-state reach. The final dispatch said: the coalition is holding. That is what an organizer reports when the work is done.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME] TAKES THE SHOW ON THE ROAD — FIVE TILES LIBERATED, CROWD ESTIMATED LARGE
short_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] Has Liberated Five Tiles and Made It Look Easy. The Crowd Was Impressed.
long_desc: A Carnival Barker liberates territory the way they run a carnival: with energy, with showmanship, and with the persistent ability to make the audience believe the outcome was inevitable. Five tiles. [COMMANDER_NAME] filed a single dispatch: good crowd.

headline: [COMMANDER_NAME]'S GRAND TOUR IS COMPLETE — THE CARNIVAL HAS CLOSED ITS FINAL SHOW
short_desc: Five Tiles. 100 Gold. Commander Present. The Barker Takes a Bow.
long_desc: Three objectives and [COMMANDER_NAME] made all of them look effortless, which required considerable effort. The final dispatch was theatrical and correct: the house is full, the till is healthy, and the Republic's most flamboyant field commander is accepting a standing ovation. How they prefer to end a show.

headline: OTTAWA HAS FALLEN
short_desc: King George III Claims the Republic. The Capital Burns.
long_desc: The last smoke from Parliament Hill rose at dusk. Crown forces entered Ottawa without ceremony — there was no one left to argue about ceremony. Prime Minister Jessica Commanda Odjick had withdrawn west with the remnants of the Republican Army. The Governor-General's residence now flies a different flag. The Republic‚ as constituted‚ has no capital. Clear-Water issued a final communiqué from somewhere in the Ottawa Valley: this is not over. King George III‚ for his part‚ declared the matter settled. The matter is not settled.

headline: JESSICA CLEAR-WATER HAS FALLEN
short_desc: The Prime Minister Is Gone. The Republic Grieves.
long_desc: There are no confirmed reports. There are fourteen unconfirmed reports. Marc Penoit has not spoken publicly since the dispatch reached Quebec City. He sat in the command tent with the message for one hour and then began issuing orders — not to mourn‚ not to negotiate‚ but to redeploy. The French Habitants have closed ranks. The Haudenosaunee delegation sent no message. They sent warriors. Jessica Commanda Odjick‚ who came to Ottawa not as a supplicant but as the only person in the room who had been right about every British promise for forty years‚ is gone. The Republic she built is still here. That must be enough.

headline: MARC PENOIT REQUESTS A WAR COUNCIL
short_desc: The Deputy Governor Has Opinions About the Eastern Flank. Several of Them Are Correct.
long_desc: The dispatch from Quebec City arrived at Prime Ministerial residence before breakfast and was considerably longer than any dispatch needed to be — Marc Penoit has opinions about supply chains‚ the eastern flank‚ the positioning of the 3rd Militia‚ and at least one strong objection to a recent deployment decision he did not make. He requests a formal war council. He will‚ he notes‚ be arriving regardless of whether the request is approved.

headline: PENOIT COUNSELS RESTRAINT — OR POSSIBLY AGGRESSION
short_desc: The Deputy Governor Has Read the Numbers and Has Thoughts.
long_desc: Marc Penoit spread the territorial maps across the floor of the command tent and pointed at each one in turn. His analysis was precise‚ quietly furious‚ and correct. The Republic's grip on the eastern territories is weaker than the official reports suggest. He is not panicking. He is doing the thing he always does: seeing the situation clearly and telling you about it at length. The Prime Minister has the option to listen or to delegate. He will notice which option is chosen.

headline: PENOIT QUESTIONS THE MILITIA'S RESOLVE
short_desc: Morale in the Quebec Corridor Is Low. The Deputy Governor Is Not Surprised.
long_desc: The French Habitants have been holding the Saint Lawrence corridor for six weeks without reinforcement‚ relief‚ or any apparent acknowledgement from the capital that the corridor exists. Marc Penoit filed a report that said‚ essentially: I told you this would happen. The report contained tactical recommendations‚ a request for additional weapons shipments‚ and a single handwritten note at the bottom: Fix this or we lose Quebec. He means it.

headline: FRENCH HABITANTS FEEL LEFT BEHIND
short_desc: A Québécois Veteran Speaks from the Capitol Steps
long_desc: French Canadian citizenry have gathered in Ottawa to demand the Prime Minister recognize their cultural autonomy rights under emergency law. "French is being systematically suppressed in the Canadian armed forces in favour of the aggressor's own language‚" one Québécois veteran declared from the capitol steps. How the Republic responds will define its relationship with its Francophone citizens for a generation.

headline: JUST IN FROM THE FRONT — PRESIDENT PENOIT IS LEADING THE CHARGE PERSONALLY
short_desc: The Deputy Governor Filed One Dispatch. It Read: I Am Where I Am Needed.
long_desc: The dispatch arrived before the reports did. Penoit has moved up. No one had ordered Penoit to move up. No one‚ apparently‚ had ordered Penoit not to. He is currently on the field at [TILE_NAME]‚ has assumed tactical command of the militia units present‚ and by all accounts is personally leading saber charges against the Crown's infantry. The photography unit has images. Prime Minister Clear-Water has seen the images. She is deciding whether to release them to the public — valuable as a symbol of presidential courage‚ dangerous as an invitation for every soldier in Quebec to believe they can do the same. Both assessments are correct.

headline: PENOIT ADDRESSES THE REPUBLIC: THE ELECTION IS COMING
short_desc: The Deputy Governor Has Prepared a Speech. It Is Not a Short Speech.
long_desc: Marc Penoit has not historically been a speech-giver. He is a report-writer‚ a flank-watcher‚ a person who disagrees with the alliance about once a week but never enough to leave. The speech he delivered in Quebec City was thirty-two minutes long and contained precise tactical breakdowns‚ three direct appeals to French Habitant constituents‚ and one moment at the end that was quiet and uncharacteristically personal. He said: I did not march this far to hand the colony back to London in a different hat. The crowd responded appropriately.

headline: PENOIT AND THE PROTECTORS — THE DEPUTY GOVERNOR ACKNOWLEDGES THE CREATURES
short_desc: He Stepped Outside This Morning. The Snow Was Different.
long_desc: Marc Penoit has spent thirty years writing reports about things he could measure. This morning he went outside and stood in the snow for a long time and did not write anything. His dog was with him. The dog seemed to know where to walk. The Quebec woods that have been wrong since before the first muster — too quiet‚ too cold‚ something absent from the underside of things — are not wrong anymore. He has three protector acknowledgments on file. He did not understand what they meant when he signed them. He stood in the snow until the cold became unremarkable and then he came inside and wrote one line in the daily report: the land has changed. Filed it. Did not explain.

headline: FIELD CITATION — [COMMANDER_NAME]
short_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] Has Reached Second Rank. The Republic Notes the Service.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] has met the standard for second-rank field citation. The Republic does not hand these out casually. The paperwork was filed from Washington. It reads: demonstrated command capacity under sustained field conditions. The record is updated. Headquarters concurs.

headline: GENERAL [COMMANDER_NAME] — WHITE HOUSE RECOGNITION CEREMONY
short_desc: Ualani Presents the Third-Rank Citation. It Was a Good Ceremony.
long_desc: The White House advance team filed four memos before [COMMANDER_NAME] arrived. Three were standard. The fourth concerned the apple boxes — the standing order to locate them whenever an honoree's height differential with President Ualani exceeds comfortable framing range. The boxes were already positioned when [COMMANDER_NAME] walked in. The full service record was read aloud. President Ualani shook [COMMANDER_NAME]'s hand for an unusually long time. [COMMANDER_NAME] appeared genuinely moved. The press pool described it as 'the good kind of ceremony.' White House Production marked the event: Complete.

headline: GENERAL [COMMANDER_NAME] — THE LINCOLN BEDROOM
short_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] Had Never Felt So Taken Care Of.
long_desc: [COMMANDER_NAME] had held difficult ground for the better part of a year. It showed — not in their posture but in the pauses between sentences‚ in the way veterans carry things nobody asks them about. Ualani noticed. She had made a plan for the evening. She discarded the plan. Instead she turned the entire night around — not toward herself but toward [COMMANDER_NAME]‚ toward the quiet question of what a general actually needs when no one is watching and nothing is being asked in return. [COMMANDER_NAME] had not expected that. The Lincoln Bedroom has a long record. It added another entry.
